title: Special Topics in HCI; Social and Psychological Impacts of AI
description: Explores human-AI interaction from a social science perspective with a focus on understanding how humans perceive, interact with, and are influenced by AI systems, drawing on social scientific theories from psychology, communication, social computing, and beyond. Covers AI anthropomorphism, AI s persuasive power, explainable AI, AI for information seeking, human-centered AI in health, AI and human confidence and creativity, AI aversion and overreliance, AI and misinformation, AI reasoning and biases, and AI for social scientific research.
